name: ForwardEmail
description: Forwards an existing email message using Microsoft Graph.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: mailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The mailbox containing the message to forward.

fields.name: messageId
fields.label: Message ID
fields.description: The Microsoft Graph message identifier of the email to forward.

fields.name: comment
fields.label: Comment
fields.description: Optional message to include above the forwarded email.

fields.name: To
fields.label: To
fields.description: Primary recipient email address(es). Separate multiple addresses with semicolons (;).

fields.name: CC
fields.label: CC
fields.description: Carbon copy recipient email address(es). Separate multiple addresses with semicolons (;).

fields.name: BCC
fields.label: BCC
fields.description: Blind carbon copy recipient email address(es). Separate multiple addresses with semicolons (;).

fields.name: SubjectMode
fields.label: Forward Subject Mode
fields.description: Defines how the email subject should be constructed when forwarding.

selectOptions.label: Keep Original
selectOptions.description: Forward using the original subject unchanged

selectOptions.label: Custom Prefix
selectOptions.description: Adds user-defined text before the original subject

selectOptions.label: Custom Suffix
selectOptions.description: Adds user-defined text after the original subject

selectOptions.label: Replace Entire Subject
selectOptions.description: Completely replaces the original subject with a new one

fields.name: Subject
fields.label: Subject
fields.description: Custom text or template used for subject transformation (depends on selected mode).

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the status of the forward operation.
